metaDescription: Order custom Eddie Bauer dress shirts in bulk for your team. Shop premium styles with logo embroidery at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Eddie Bauer dress shirts combine classic style with performance fabrics, making them a top choice for corporate uniforms and team apparel. The wrinkle-resistant cotton and easy-care finishes keep your team looking sharp from morning meetings to evening events. Choose from button-downs and oxfords in versatile colors, then add your logo with embroidery or screen printing for a polished, professional look.
heroAltText: Custom Eddie Bauer dress shirts with embroidered logo for corporate uniforms
